question: A can complete a work in 10 days and B can complete it in 15 days. If they work on it together for 5 days, then the fraction of the work left will be:
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 10 days

B can complete the work in 15 days

They together work for 5 days

**Concept used:**

Work done = Efficiency × Time taken

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of A = 1/10

The efficiency of B = 1/15

Total efficiency = 1/10 + 1/15

Total time = 5 days

Now, Work done = Efficiency × Time taken

⇒ (1/10 + 1/15) × 5

⇒ (5/30) × 5

⇒ Work done = 5/6
